questions.question_fa: خانم ۳۰ سالهای با درد مچ پای دو طرف که از یک هفته قبل شروع شده مراجعه کرده است. در معاینه هر دو مچ پا متورم و تندر و محدوده ی حرکات پاسیو طبیعی است پالکها ی تندر بنفش رنگ روی ساق دو طرف دیده میشود. گام بعدی تشخیص کدام است؟
questions.question_en: A 30-year-old woman presented with bilateral ankle pain that started a week ago. In the examination, both ankles are swollen and tender, and the range of motion is normal. Violet-colored blisters can be seen on the leg on both sides. What is the next step in diagnosis?

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «رادیوگرافی قفسه ی صدری» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.

micro.lead_en: Löfgren syndrome represents an acute benign presentation of sarcoidosis defined by the classic triad of bilateral hilar adenopathy on chest radiography, painful erythema nodosum over the pretibial regions, and acute bilateral ankle periarthritis.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Bilateral ankle periarthritis + erythema nodosum = Löfgren syndrome (acute sarcoidosis); next step: chest X-ray.

دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Tissue biopsy is unnecessary when the full classical clinical-radiological triad of Löfgren syndrome is present.
First-line management centers on bed rest and short-course nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs).
Colchicine offers effective second-line relief for persistent painful erythema nodosum.
Passive ankle range of motion remains largely preserved because inflammation is predominately periarticular.

micro.lead_en: Reactive arthritis is a seronegative spondyloarthropathy developing 1 to 4 weeks following enteritis (Shigella, Salmonella, Campylobacter) or genitourinary infection (Chlamydia). Classic triad features inflammatory asymmetric oligoarthritis, conjunctivitis, and non-gonococcal urethritis with prominent enthesitis.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Lower extremity arthritis + Achilles enthesitis + conjunctivitis post-enteritis = reactive arthritis.
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: HLA-B27 is positive in 60-80% of severe reactive arthritis presentations.
High-dose continuous NSAIDs (e.g., indomethacin, naproxen) represent the foundational first-line therapy.
Post-dysenteric reactive arthritis derives no articular therapeutic benefit from antibacterial therapy.
Sulfasalazine is the preferred disease-modifying agent when peripheral arthritis persists beyond 3-6 months.

Acute febrile monoarthritis requires urgent arthrocentesis for Gram stain, leukocyte count, and culture, coupled with blood cultures and immediate intravenous bactericidal therapy.

points_en: Staphylococcus aureus is the predominant causative pathogen implicated in rheumatoid joint sepsis.
Empiric antimicrobial coverage must cover MRSA and gram-negative bacilli simultaneously.
Intra-articular steroid instillation is strictly prohibited until bacterial sepsis is definitively ruled out.
Serial therapeutic joint aspirations decompress intra-articular pressure and evacuate damaging enzymes.

The axial skeleton and sacroiliac joints are spared in SLE, making inflammatory back pain absent.

points_en: Significant proteinuria warrants percutaneous renal biopsy to stage histologic nephritis class.

Lupus psychosis and seizures require high-dose pulse corticosteroids and aggressive immunosuppression.
Lupus peripheral arthritis is non-erosive and reducible (Jaccoud arthropathy), preserving joint architecture.

micro.lead_en: Bicipital tendinitis represents friction inflammation of the long head of the biceps brachii tendon. It produces anterior shoulder tenderness along the bicipital groove. Yergason's maneuver (resisted active forearm supination with elbow flexed to 90°) selectively tensions the tendon, reproducing anterior shoulder pain.

points_en: Speed's test offers greater sensitivity than Yergason's maneuver in identifying biceps tendinopathy.
Point tenderness along the bicipital groove is the most localized physical finding.
Conservative therapy mandates relative rest, avoiding overhead lifting strain, and NSAIDs.
Ultrasound-guided peritendinous corticosteroid infiltration provides prompt symptomatic relief.

questions.explanation_en: Gout is caused by monosodium urate with needle crystal and negative birefringence and CPPD with positive rhomboid crystal. Acute attack is treated with NSAID, colchicine or steroid and initiation/modification of urate-lowering with anti-attack cover. Septic arthritis is always an important distinction and the presence of crystals does not rule out infection. The urate goal is usually below 6 mg/dL.

micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.

Targeted biologic therapies including TNF-alpha, IL-17, and IL-23 inhibitors effectively control skin and joint disease.
Methotrexate is the preferred initial disease-modifying agent addressing joint and plaque involvement.

The classic triad encompasses upper respiratory tract ulcerations/sinusitis, cavitary pulmonary nodules, and glomerulonephritis, strongly anchored by c-ANCA (anti-PR3) positivity.

points_en: Histopathology demonstrates necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis with mixed inflammatory infiltrates.
Renal disease manifests as rapidly progressive pauci-immune crescentic necrotizing glomerulonephritis.
Remission induction mandates high-dose glucocorticoids combined with rituximab or cyclophosphamide.
Prophylactic trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole prevents Pneumocystis jirovecii and reduces upper airway relapse rates.

HLA-B27 testing provides supportive genetic risk stratification but does not supplant diagnostic imaging.

micro.lead_en: Inflammatory back pain persisting for a year in a 42-year-old male strongly implicates axial spondyloarthritis. An anteroposterior pelvic radiograph evaluating the sacroiliac joints represents the requisite initial diagnostic maneuver to establish structural sacroiliitis.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.

points_en: Bilateral symmetric sacroiliitis on pelvic radiography is the defining hallmark of primary ankylosing spondylitis.
When conventional radiographs remain normal, sacroiliac MRI detects early pre-radiographic subchondral osteitis.
Daily structured spinal stretching exercises preserve long-term functional spinal mobility.
Biologic TNF inhibitors are indicated upon failure of at least two consecutive NSAID trials.

questions.question_en: A 45-year-old female patient has a case of diabetes since one year ago. He came with a complaint of pain and swelling of the right knee. Strict blood pressure optimization and continuous hydroxychloroquine protect long-term renal survival.

micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Shoulder pain in a diabetic patient + global active and passive restriction = adhesive capsulitis (frozen shoulder).
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Intra-articular glenohumeral corticosteroid injection combined with physical stretching represents first-line therapy.
Differential vs rotator cuff tears: passive range is preserved in cuff tears, whereas capsulitis restricts all planes.
Natural progression spans 1-2 years through freezing, frozen, and gradual thawing stages.
Rigorous glycemic optimization helps prevent bilateral contralateral shoulder involvement.

micro.lead_en: Ischemic digital ulcers in systemic sclerosis arise from proliferative obliterative vasculopathy. Bosentan, an oral dual endothelin-1 receptor antagonist, has been shown in the RAPIDS randomized trials to significantly reduce the occurrence of new digital ulcers in at-risk systemic sclerosis cohorts.

points_en: Bosentan effectively prevents future new digital ulcers but does not accelerate healing of pre-existing ulcers.
Monthly liver transaminase monitoring is strictly mandated due to potential dose-dependent hepatotoxicity.
Active non-healing refractory ischemic ulcers are treated with intravenous prostacyclin analogs (iloprost).
Dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers (nifedipine) form baseline therapy for vasospastic Raynaud phenomenon.

questions.explanation_en: Gout is caused by monosodium urate with needle crystal and negative birefringence and CPPD with positive rhomboid crystal. Acute attack is treated with NSAID, colchicine or steroid and initiation/modification of urate-lowering with anti-attack cover. Septic arthritis is always an important distinction and the presence of crystals does not rule out infection. The urate goal is usually below 6 mg/dL.

micro.lead_en: Managing an acute gout flare in moderate-to-severe renal impairment (GFR 30 mL/min) is complicated by the nephrotoxicity of NSAIDs and the heightened toxicity risks of colchicine. In single accessible large-joint flares with confirmed sterile fluid, intra-articular corticosteroid injection provides the safest, most rapid anti-inflammatory response.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.

دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Oral systemic prednisone is an acceptable alternative when multiple joints are involved in renal disease.
Urate-lowering allopurinol must never be newly initiated during an active acute gout flare.
Monosodium urate crystals display characteristic needle morphology with strong negative birefringence.
Long-term urate-lowering therapy should be initiated post-flare, adjusting starting doses strictly for GFR.

Osteoclast-mediated bone resorption at capsular insertion points causes classic marginal radiographic erosions.

micro.lead_en: Adhesive capsulitis (frozen shoulder) represents a chronic capsular fibrotic contracture strongly linked to diabetes mellitus. Its hallmark diagnostic feature is global, symmetrical restriction of both active and passive glenohumeral excursion across all planes, often with disuse osteopenia on plain radiographs.

points_en: External rotation is typically the most severely and early restricted motion on physical examination.
Intra-articular glenohumeral corticosteroid injections paired with stretching exercises constitute standard therapy.
High-volume capsular hydrodilatation physically releases fibrotic adhesions in refractory cases.
Rotator cuff tears preserve passive range of motion, whereas adhesive capsulitis locks passive motion.

micro.lead_en: Dermatomyositis is fundamentally a complement-mediated microangiopathy targeting endomysial capillaries. Deposition of the C5b-9 membrane attack complex triggers capillary necrosis, thrombosis, and secondary ischemic perifascicular myofiber atrophy, with perivascular infiltrates dominated by B cells and CD4+ T helper cells.

points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Perifascicular muscle fiber atrophy is a pathognomonic histopathological hallmark of dermatomyositis.
Polymyositis involves direct antigen-driven cytotoxic CD8+ T-cell invasion of non-necrotic myofibers.
High-dose systemic glucocorticoids (prednisone 1 mg/kg/day) form the foundational first-line therapy.
Comprehensive age- and gender-appropriate oncologic screening is mandatory in all adult dermatomyositis cases.

In the examination, the joints have significant tenderness along with swelling and warmth and a brief erythema of the right knee and a severe decrease in the joint range of motion. In initial tests: WBC=12700(90% PMN), Hb: 13.2, EST: 30, CRP: 3+, PLT: 366,000 What is the appropriate action?

points_en: Intra-articular corticosteroid infiltration prior to ruling out infection causes catastrophic joint destruction.
Synovial fluid leukocyte count >50,000/μL with >90% neutrophils strongly confirms bacterial joint infection.
Empiric intravenous antibiotic regimens must cover Staphylococcus aureus and gram-negative bacilli.
Simultaneous compensated polarized light microscopy evaluates for concurrent monosodium urate crystals.

micro.lead_en: Fibromyalgia represents a chronic generalized nociplastic pain syndrome driven by central sensitization. Characterized by widespread musculoskeletal aching, unrefreshing sleep, fatigue, and widespread soft tissue tenderness without articular swelling, standard evaluation requires testing ESR and CRP to rule out occult inflammatory conditions.

points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Acute-phase reactants (ESR and CRP) are characteristically entirely normal in primary fibromyalgia.
Non-pharmacologic management emphasizing low-impact aerobic exercise, hydrotherapy, and CBT forms first-line care.
FDA-approved pharmacological options include duloxetine, milnacipran, and pregabalin.
Opioid analgesics are strictly contraindicated due to inefficacy and risk of opioid-induced hyperalgesia.

micro.lead_en: Inflammatory involvement of the distal interphalangeal (DIP) joints is a hallmark of psoriatic arthritis, a site characteristically spared by rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus. DIP synovitis is tightly linked to psoriatic nail dystrophy due to the close anatomic continuity between the nail matrix and extensor enthesis.

points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Careful clinical inspection of scalp, umbilicus, and gluteal cleft uncovers hidden plaque psoriasis.
Psoriatic nail changes (pitting, oil-drop discoloration, onycholysis) correlate tightly with DIP disease.
Plain hand radiography shows concurrent erosion and bone proliferation, culminating in 'pencil-in-cup' changes.
Rheumatoid factor and anti-CCP autoantibodies are characteristically negative in psoriatic arthritis.

Quadriceps isometric strengthening exercises stabilize tibiofemoral tracking and alleviate symptoms.
Topical NSAIDs are the preferred first-line pharmacotherapy due to minimal systemic absorption.
Weight-bearing plain radiography demonstrates medial compartment narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophytes.

points_en: The supraspinatus tendon initiates abduction and is anatomically most vulnerable to subacromial impingement.
Hawkins-Kennedy and Neer provocative maneuvers reliably elicit subacromial impingement symptoms.
The drop arm sign specifically detects full-thickness tears of the supraspinatus tendon.
First-line management centers on active overhead rest, rotator cuff rehabilitation, and short-course NSAIDs.

micro.lead_en: Synovial fluid is categorized as non-inflammatory (<2,000/μL), inflammatory (2,000-50,000/μL), or purulent/septic (>50,000/μL with >90% PMNs). Group II inflammatory synovial fluid displays translucency loss and reduced string sign viscosity.

micro.lead_en: Hyperuricemia stems from urate overproduction (diffuse psoriasis, myeloproliferative disorders) or impaired renal excretion (diuretics, chronic kidney disease, metabolic acidosis). points_en: Diabetic ketoacidosis and starvation ketoacidosis suppress renal tubular uric acid excretion.
Ethanol metabolism accelerates hepatic adenine nucleotide degradation, boosting urate synthesis.
Urinary alkalinization with sodium/potassium citrate enhances uric acid solubility.
Thiazide diuretics are the most frequent iatrogenic cause precipitating clinical gout flares.

Non-contrast lumbar MRI is the definitive imaging modality confirming root compromise.

Synovial fluid in acute monoarthritis is necessary to rule out septic/crystal arthritis. Early DMARD therapy prevents structural damage.

micro.lead_fa: کدام گزینه بیشترین تطابق را با رفرنس و سناریو دارد؟
micro.lead_en: Knee osteoarthritis is the primary degenerative weight-bearing arthropathy in older females. Cardinal manifestations feature mechanical activity-induced joint pain, transient morning stiffness (<30 minutes), and palpable joint crepitus stemming from cartilage erosion and irregular subchondral articulating surfaces.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Weight-bearing knee pain + palpable crepitus without inflammatory effusion = knee osteoarthritis.
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Crepitus is the tactile sensation of rough denuded subchondral bone surfaces rubbing together.
Core management emphasizes therapeutic weight reduction, quadriceps conditioning, and topical NSAIDs.
Weight-bearing plain radiography confirms joint space narrowing, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophytosis.
Intra-articular steroid injections deliver transient (2-4 weeks) palliative anti-inflammatory benefit.

questions.question_fa: آقای ۵۰ سالهای به علت تورم زانوی راست که از سه روز قبل شروع شده مراجعه نموده است. در آنالیز مایع مفصل کریستالها ی سوزنی شکل با انکسار مضاعف منفی قوی در داخل و خارج PMN ها مشاهده شده است. کدام اقدام درمانی زیر در حال حاضر مناسب است؟
questions.question_en: A 50-year-old man came to the hospital due to swelling of his right knee that started three days ago. In joint fluid analysis, needle-shaped crystals with strong negative birefringence were observed inside and outside PMNs. Which of the following therapeutic measures is currently appropriate?
options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «Probenecid» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.
صحیح است؛ «Colchicine» منطبق بر رفرنس رسمی (اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش روماتولوژی، بیماری‌های سیستم ایمنی و مفاصل)، پاسخ صحیح و مسیر بالینی استاندارد است.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «Allopurinol» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «Colchicine» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «Colchicine» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Gout is caused by monosodium urate with needle crystal and negative birefringence and CPPD with positive rhomboid crystal. Acute attack is treated with NSAID, colchicine or steroid and initiation/modification of urate-lowering with anti-attack cover. Septic arthritis is always an important distinction and the presence of crystals does not rule out infection. The urate goal is usually below 6 mg/dL.

micro.lead_en: Monosodium urate crystals are needle-shaped with bright negative birefringence under polarized microscopy. Acute management focuses exclusively on rapid anti-inflammatory abortive therapy using low-dose colchicine, full-dose NSAIDs, or corticosteroids. Urate-lowering therapy must never be initiated during an active flare.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Acute gout flare with negative birefringent needles = abortive therapy with colchicine or NSAIDs (allopurinol contraindicated acutely).
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Low-dose colchicine (1.0 mg followed by 0.5 mg 1 hour later) matches high-dose efficacy without toxicity.
CPPD pseudogout crystals exhibit rhomboid morphology with weak positive birefringence.
Urate-lowering therapy initiation should be deferred for 2 to 4 weeks post-flare resolution.
Initiating allopurinol requires concurrent low-dose colchicine flare prophylaxis for 3-6 months.

micro.lead_en: Synovial fluid analysis in acute monoarthritis requires physical assessment, cell count with differential, Gram stain, bacterial culture, and compensated polarized microscopy for crystals. Biochemical testing for protein, LDH, and pH lacks diagnostic specificity and is explicitly unnecessary.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Essential synovial fluid tests: cell count, Gram stain, culture, crystals; measuring protein, LDH, and pH is unindicated.
points_fa: گزینه برتر: بررسی پروتئین LDH، pH مایع مفصلی
دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Synovial leukocyte counts >50,000/μL with >90% polymorphonuclears strongly point to bacterial infection.
Identifying intracellular urate crystals confirms gout but does not exclude concomitant septic arthritis.
Gram stain demonstrates causative microorganisms in 50-70% of non-gonococcal bacterial infections.
Serum uric acid levels may transiently normalize in up to one-third of acute gout flare presentations.

micro.lead_en: De Quervain tenosynovitis represents stenosing tenosynovitis of the first extensor compartment enclosing the APL and EPB tendons over the radial styloid. Frequently afflicting postpartum mothers lifting infants, the diagnostic hallmark is a positive Finkelstein maneuver producing sharp pain upon ulnar deviation of the fist-enclosed thumb.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.

points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: The tendons involved are the abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis.
A thumb-spica splint provides biomechanical immobilization of the first ray, promoting healing.
Intrasheath corticosteroid injection achieves curative resolution in >80% of uncomplicated presentations.
Surgical decompression of the first dorsal compartment is reserved for refractory chronic cases.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «انجام اسپیرومتری» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «انجام اسپیرومتری» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.

micro.lead_en: Anti-topoisomerase I (anti-Scl-70) positivity in systemic sclerosis is tightly correlated with progressive interstitial lung disease (ILD). Initial surveillance mandates baseline pulmonary function testing (spirometry, lung volumes, and DLCO) alongside high-resolution chest CT to detect early alveolar restriction.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Raynaud + positive anti-Scl-70 = screen for pulmonary fibrosis with spirometry, DLCO, and chest HRCT.
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Disproportionate DLCO reduction represents the earliest functional indicator of microvascular and alveolar disease.
Active progressive SSc-ILD mandates immunosuppression with mycophenolate mofetil or cyclophosphamide.
Tocilizumab (anti-IL-6 receptor antagonist) preserves forced vital capacity in progressive diffuse disease.
Conventional chest radiography possesses dismal sensitivity for early ground-glass interstitial infiltrates.

micro.lead_en: Diagnostic classification criteria for systemic lupus erythematosus strictly incorporate cytopenias: leukopenia (<4,000/μL), lymphopenia (<1,500/μL), thrombocytopenia (<100,000/μL), and autoimmune hemolytic anemia. Leukocytosis is never a criterion for SLE; its presence prompts suspicion of intercurrent infection or steroid effect.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.

points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Leukocytosis emerging in a lupus patient represents a critical red flag for intercurrent bacterial infection.
Exogenous glucocorticoid therapy induces demargination granulocytosis, mimicking systemic infection.
Anemia in SLE typically stems from chronic disease or Coombs-positive autoimmune hemolytic destruction.
Fulfillment of at least 4 criteria (including clinical and immunologic domains) establishes classification.

micro.lead_en: Takayasu arteritis is a chronic granulomatous large-vessel vasculitis targeting the aorta and its major branches, predominantly afflicting young females under 40. Hallmark findings feature upper limb claudication, asymmetric or absent peripheral pulses, and blood pressure discrepancy >10-20 mmHg between arms.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.

points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: CT or MR angiography represents the non-invasive imaging modality of choice, delineating mural thickening and stenoses.
High-dose systemic corticosteroid therapy (prednisone 1 mg/kg/day) forms the cornerstone of remission induction.
Biologic agents targeting IL-6 (tocilizumab) or TNF-alpha demonstrate robust efficacy in refractory arteritis.
Surgical vascular reconstruction or angioplasty must be deferred until active systemic inflammation is fully arrested.

micro.lead_en: Differentiating mechanical from inflammatory joint pain is fundamental: osteoarthritis produces load-dependent pain relieved by rest, morning stiffness under 15 minutes, and normal inflammatory markers. Low-titer rheumatoid factor is an incidental finding in up to 15% of healthy elderly individuals and should not mislead the clinician.

micro.golden_en: Mechanical knee pain + brief morning stiffness + normal ESR = osteoarthritis; low-titer RF in the elderly is non-specific.

points_en: Morning gel phenomenon in osteoarthritis typically resolves within minutes of ambulation.
Core conservative management focuses on weight reduction, quadriceps exercises, and topical NSAIDs.
Weight-bearing plain radiography confirms characteristic joint space narrowing and marginal osteophytosis.
Low-titer rheumatoid factor in the absence of clinical synovitis never justifies immunosuppressive therapy.

questions.explanation_en: Gout is caused by monosodium urate with needle crystal and negative birefringence and CPPD with positive rhomboid crystal. Acute attack is treated with NSAID, colchicine or steroid and initiation/modification of urate-lowering with anti-attack cover. Septic arthritis is always an important distinction and the presence of crystals does not rule out infection. The urate goal is usually below 6 mg/dL.

micro.lead_en: Urate-lowering therapy with allopurinol is lifelong and strongly discouraged for asymptomatic hyperuricemia. The ACR guidelines delineate firm indications for initiating allopurinol: presence of subcutaneous tophi, radiographic damage attributable to gout, or frequent clinical flares (≥2 attacks per year).
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Indications for allopurinol in gout: tophi, nephrolithiasis, or ≥2 flares per year; asymptomatic hyperuricemia is not treated.

points_en: Allopurinol should be initiated at low doses (≤100 mg/day, lower in CKD) and titrated upward every 2-4 weeks.

Concomitant anti-inflammatory flare prophylaxis with low-dose colchicine is mandatory for 3-6 months.
Screening for the HLA-B*5801 allele prevents life-threatening severe cutaneous adverse reactions in high-risk populations.

micro.lead_en: Polyarteritis nodosa (PAN) is a necrotizing systemic vasculitis targeting medium-sized muscular arteries. Key hallmarks include renovascular hypertension and renal failure without capillaritis, mononeuritis multiplex (wrist drop), and characteristic microaneurysms on visceral angiography, often linked to hepatitis B.

points_en: Glomerular capillaries and the pulmonary circulation are characteristically strictly spared in classic PAN.
Classical polyarteritis nodosa is ANCA-negative, distinguishing it from microscopic polyangiitis.
Non-viral PAN requires aggressive immunosuppression with high-dose corticosteroids and cyclophosphamide.

points_en: Standing lateral lumbar radiography quantitatively grades vertebral slip percentage (Meyerding grades I-IV).
Oblique lumbar views reveal the classic fractured-collar 'Scotty dog' sign denoting a pars defect.
Secondary neurogenic claudication and spinal canal stenosis frequently complicate degenerative slips.
Management focuses on core abdominal stabilization exercises, reserving spinal fusion for unstable progressive slips.

The defining physical hallmark is equal restriction of both active and passive motion across all planes, accompanied by normal inflammatory markers (ESR/CRP) and disuse osteopenia on radiographs.

points_en: External rotation is the earliest and most severely compromised arc of motion on clinical exam.
Intra-articular glenohumeral corticosteroid injections paired with supervised stretching constitute first-line therapy.
Passive range of motion is preserved in rotator cuff tears but globally locked in adhesive capsulitis.
Glenohumeral hydrodilatation physically disrupts dense capsular adhesions in chronic recalcitrant presentations.

micro.lead_en: De Quervain's tenosynovitis involves stenosing friction of the abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis within the first extensor compartment. Highly prevalent in pregnancy due to fluid retention and wrist wringing, Finkelstein's sign (pain provoked by passive ulnar deviation of the fist-enclosed thumb) is the hallmark physical test.

points_en: The tendons involved are the abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis.
A rigid thumb-spica splint mechanically unloads the irritated fibro-osseous compartment.
Intrasheath corticosteroid infiltration is safe during pregnancy, yielding rapid definitive symptom resolution.
Carpal tunnel syndrome causes palmar paresthesias, whereas De Quervain manifests as focal radial styloid pain.

micro.lead_en: Tuberculous arthritis characteristically presents as an insidious, chronic inflammatory 'cold' monoarthritis persisting over months to years, with knee and hip joints most frequently involved. Unlike acute pyogenic joint infections that destroy cartilage within days, skeletal tuberculosis progresses slowly, requiring synovial tissue biopsy for culture.

micro.lead_en: C7 radiculopathy is the most frequent cervical nerve root compression syndrome, predominantly provoked by C6-C7 posterolateral disc herniation. Classic neurological localization features pain radiating into the dorsal forearm and third digit (middle finger), triceps motor weakness, and a diminished triceps deep tendon reflex.

points_en: Spurling maneuver (cervical extension, ipsilateral rotation, and axial compression) reproduces radicular pain.
C6 radiculopathy selectively maps to the thumb/index finger with depressed biceps and brachioradialis reflexes.
Conservative management with short-term soft cervical collar and NSAIDs succeeds in the majority of patients.

micro.lead_en: Dactylitis (sausage digit) represents diffuse, uniform swelling of an entire digit resulting from concurrent synovitis of interphalangeal joints and tenosynovitis of the digital flexor tendons. It is a pathognomonic hallmark of psoriatic arthritis and peripheral spondyloarthropathies, characteristically absent in rheumatoid arthritis.

points_en: Dactylitis confers 1 point under the validated CASPAR diagnostic criteria for psoriatic arthritis.
Detection of a sausage digit mandates a thorough search of hidden skin sites for subtle plaque psoriasis.
Refractory dactylitis responds poorly to conventional synthetic DMARDs, requiring biologic TNF/IL-17 inhibition.
Radiographic imaging shows extensive soft tissue fusiform swelling alongside periosteal new bone formation.

Radiographic wrist arthropathy strongly prompts an etiologic workup for secondary causes including CPPD crystal deposition, hemochromatosis, or remote carpal trauma.

points_en: Isolated MCP and wrist arthropathy is a classic diagnostic clue for hereditary hemochromatosis.
First carpometacarpal (CMC1) joint osteoarthritis produces prominent local thumb base squaring and pinch pain.
Rheumatoid arthritis stands in direct contrast, demonstrating an overwhelming affinity for bilateral wrist synovitis.
CPPD disease characteristically calcifies the triangular fibrocartilage complex within the wrist joint.

micro.lead_en: Inclusion body myositis (IBM) is the most common acquired idiopathic inflammatory myopathy in patients over age 50, featuring a male predilection. Unlike polymyositis, IBM characteristically involves both proximal muscles (quadriceps femoris, causing frequent falls) and distal muscles (deep finger flexors), and is notoriously refractory to corticosteroids.

Muscle biopsy confirms pathognomonic basophilic rimmed vacuoles and amyloid-positive inclusions.
Circulating autoantibodies targeting cytosolic 5'-nucleotidase 1A (anti-cN1A) support the diagnosis.
Therapy focuses on physical therapy and assistive walking devices, as pharmacologic immunosuppression fails.

questions.explanation_en: Gout is caused by monosodium urate with needle crystal and negative birefringence and CPPD with positive rhomboid crystal. Acute attack is treated with NSAID, colchicine or steroid and initiation/modification of urate-lowering with anti-attack cover. Septic arthritis is always an important distinction and the presence of crystals does not rule out infection. The urate goal is usually below 6 mg/dL.

micro.lead_en: The heel strike (heel percussion) test applies a firm axial blow to the patient's calcaneus with the lower extremity extended. The mechanical shock wave travels proximally through the femoral shaft into the acetabulum, selectively triggering sharp groin pain in intra-articular hip pathology (coxarthrosis, femoral neck fracture, or avascular necrosis).

points_en: Passive internal rotation of the hip joint exhibits high sensitivity confirming true intra-articular disease.

Repetitive thumb pinching, gripping, and wrist wringing mechanically irritate the abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis tendons against the narrow first extensor compartment overlying the radial styloid.

Acute attack is treated with NSAID, colchicine or steroid and initiation/modification of urate-lowering with anti-attack cover. Septic arthritis is always an important distinction and the presence of crystals does not rule out infection. The urate goal is usually below 6 mg/dL.

Systemic oral corticosteroids (prednisone 30-35 mg/day tapered over 10-14 days) or intra-articular steroid injections are the safest agents.

micro.lead_en: Tuberculous monoarthritis characteristically presents as an insidious, indolent chronic monoarthritis persisting over months, with the knee being the most common peripheral site. In endemic regions, a 5-month history of joint swelling, elevated ESR, and sterile standard bacterial cultures strongly points to mycobacterial infection, requiring synovial biopsy.

points_en: Direct acid-fast staining of synovial fluid displays low sensitivity (<30%); a negative smear does not exclude TB.
Synovial tissue biopsy with mycobacterial culture represents the definitive gold standard (>85% sensitivity).
Radiographic Phemister triad exhibits juxta-articular osteopenia, joint space narrowing, and peripheral erosions.
Standard therapy mandates quadruple antituberculous chemotherapy sustained for 9 to 12 months.

micro.lead_en: Loop diuretics (furosemide) and thiazides are prominent pharmacological culprits triggering recurrent gout attacks. By inducing volume depletion, they stimulate proximal tubular reabsorption of urate, impairing renal urate excretion. Conversely, losartan uniquely exerts a uricosuric effect by blocking URAT1, making it the preferred antihypertensive in gout.

points_en: Discontinuing unnecessary diuretics or substituting them with losartan substantially reduces gout recurrences.

Acute gout attacks should be treated with short-course anti-inflammatories without altering baseline allopurinol.
Copious daily hydration facilitates renal urate clearance and prevents urinary supersaturation.

Serial assessment of disease activity strictly relies upon acute-phase reactants, predominantly erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) and C-reactive protein (CRP), embedded within composite scoring systems (DAS28).

points_en: The DAS28 disease activity score integrates tender/swollen joint counts with patient global health and ESR or CRP.
C-reactive protein responds more rapidly to therapeutic adjustments than the erythrocyte sedimentation rate.
The overarching therapeutic goal is achieving clinical remission (DAS28 <2.6) or low disease activity.
Routine repeat testing of RF and anti-CCP titers during follow-up provides zero added clinical utility.

questions.question_fa: آقای ۳۲ سالهای، معتاد تزریقی با تورم، درد و قرمزی در مفصل sternoclavicular ًسمت چپ مراجعه کرده است. در معاینه مفصل فوق کامال حساس (Tender) است. کدامیک از تشخیصها ی زیر بیشتر مطرح است؟
questions.question_en: A 32-year-old injection drug addict presented with swelling, pain and redness in the left sternoclavicular joint. In examination, the joint is extremely tender. Which of the following diagnoses is most relevant?
options_why_fa: نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «Osteoarthritis» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.
صحیح است؛ «Infectious arthritis» منطبق بر رفرنس رسمی (اصول طب داخلی هاریسون (ویرایش ۲۲)، بخش روماتولوژی، بیماری‌های سیستم ایمنی و مفاصل)، پاسخ صحیح و مسیر بالینی استاندارد است.
نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «Gouty arthritis» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.

micro.lead_en: Sternoclavicular joint septic arthritis is distinctly rare in the general population but exhibits an extraordinary predilection for intravenous drug users. Hematogenous seeding of fibrocartilaginous axial articulations typically involves Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus, presenting as acute erythema and exquisite localized tenderness.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: IV drug user + red tender sternoclavicular joint = infectious (septic) arthritis (Pseudomonas or S. aureus).
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus are the predominant causative microorganisms in IV drug users.
Chest CT or MRI is required to rule out contiguous osteomyelitis, retrosternal phlegmon, or mediastinitis.
Empiric intravenous therapy must combine vancomycin with an antipseudomonal beta-lactam (cefepime/meropenem).
Extensive bone erosion or retrosternal extension mandates surgical joint debridement or resection.

Complement and urine show renal activity. The treatment is based on the involved organ and severity, and the infection is rejected before immunosuppression.

micro.lead_en: New-onset peripheral edema in an established systemic lupus erythematosus patient raises urgent suspicion for nephrotic syndrome driven by active lupus nephritis. Essential laboratory surveillance incorporates urinalysis, 24-hour proteinuria, serum creatinine, complement levels (C3/C4), and anti-dsDNA titers. Anti-U1-RNP testing provides zero diagnostic value here.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Evaluating edema in SLE: U/A, proteinuria, creatinine, C3/C4, and dsDNA; anti-U1-RNP is non-contributory.
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Hypocomplementemia coupled with rising anti-dsDNA titers classically heralds an active lupus nephritis flare.
Proteinuria exceeding 0.5 to 1.0 g/day establishes a firm indication for percutaneous ultrasound-guided renal biopsy.
ACE inhibitors or ARBs serve as crucial adjunctive antiproteinuric and renoprotective agents.
Hydroxychloroquine therapy must be sustained continuously to enhance renal and overall survival.

questions.question_en: A 60-year-old diabetic lady who visited the emergency room 1 week ago due to fever, pain and swelling of her right knee. In the examination, the right knee is warm, erythematous and sensitive to the touch and has effusion and the patient has a fever. Aspiration of the right knee is performed. The characteristics of the joint fluid of the above patient correspond to which of the following.

micro.lead_en: Group III septic synovial fluid denotes acute purulent bacterial arthritis. Key laboratory findings include turbid, frankly purulent appearance, profound neutrophilic leukocytosis (WBC >50,000-100,000/μL with >90% polymorphonuclears), and markedly diminished viscosity secondary to bacterial hyaluronidase degradation.

points_en: Synovial Gram stain should be evaluated immediately following aspiration for early pathogen identification.
Synovial fluid bacterial culture remains the gold standard directing targeted pathogen-specific therapy.
Immediate empiric broad-spectrum intravenous antimicrobial therapy must follow joint decompression.
Severe crystalline arthropathy flares (hyperacute gout) can occasionally produce pseudo-septic counts.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «تورم و تندرنس در مچ دستها» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «تورم و تندرنس در مچ دستها» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Inflammatory arthritis is characterized by prolonged morning stiffness, joint swelling, and improvement with movement. RA mainly involves the MCP/PIP and the wrist symmetrically, and anti-CCP is more specific. Spondyloarthritis is associated with axial pain, enthesitis, dactylitis and HLA-B27. Synovial fluid in acute monoarthritis is necessary to rule out septic/crystal arthritis. Early DMARD therapy prevents structural damage.

micro.lead_en: Joint distribution is the paramount discriminator separating rheumatoid arthritis from osteoarthritis. Osteoarthritis targets the DIPs, first CMC, knees, and hips, characteristically sparing the radiocarpal wrist joint. Conversely, rheumatoid arthritis universally attacks the wrists, MCPs, and PIPs, strictly sparing the DIP joints.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Wrist joint swelling and tenderness = supports rheumatoid arthritis and strongly argues against primary osteoarthritis.

دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Distal interphalangeal (DIP) joints are characteristically spared in rheumatoid arthritis.
Heberden (DIP) and Bouchard (PIP) nodes are hard bony hallmarks of hand osteoarthritis.
Osteoarthritis features mechanical loading pain and brief stiffness, contrasted with prolonged RA morning stiffness.
Wrist involvement in an osteoarthritic pattern only occurs secondary to remote fracture or metabolic CPPD.

micro.lead_en: The straight leg raise (SLR) is sensitive but non-specific for lumbar disc herniation. The crossed straight leg raise test (well-leg raise), wherein elevating the asymptomatic contralateral lower extremity reproduces radicular pain in the affected limb, demonstrates superior diagnostic specificity (>90%) for nerve root compression.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Most specific physical examination test for sciatic radiculopathy = Crossed SLR test (>90% specificity).
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: A positive crossed SLR strongly correlates with a large, extruded, or paracentral disc herniation.
Classic direct SLR elicits true shooting radicular pain extending below the knee between 30° and 70°.
The reverse straight leg raise (femoral stretch test) selectively evaluates high lumbar roots (L2-L4).
Lumbar MRI without contrast provides definitive anatomic confirmation when radicular signs are present.

micro.lead_en: Hematologic manifestations of systemic lupus erythematosus are universally cytopenic, incorporating autoimmune hemolytic anemia, leukopenia, lymphopenia, and immune thrombocytopenia (<100,000/μL). Marked thrombocytosis (platelets 600,000/μL) is incompatible with primary SLE pathology, signaling severe intercurrent infection or iron deficiency.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.

points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Jaccoud's arthropathy represents a non-erosive, passively reducible joint deformity typical of chronic SLE.
Severe immune thrombocytopenia in SLE responds to high-dose systemic steroids and intravenous immunoglobulin.
Cognitive dysfunction and mood disorders affect over 30-50% of patients with neuropsychiatric lupus.
Emergence of reactive thrombocytosis mandates a rigorous diagnostic search for intercurrent occult sepsis.

micro.lead_en: Dermatomyositis manifests with symmetric proximal limb weakness, neck flexor weakness, elevated muscle enzymes, and pathognomonic cutaneous eruptions (heliotrope rash, Gottron papules). Fundamentally, primary myopathies spare deep tendon reflexes (DTRs) and sensation until end-stage muscle atrophy; early hyporeflexia strongly argues against myopathy.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Deep tendon reflexes are preserved in dermatomyositis; depressed reflexes signify neuropathy rather than myopathy.

دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Heliotrope rash presents as a violaceous periorbital erythema frequently complicated by soft tissue edema.
Gottron papules are erythematous-to-violaceous scaling plaques situated across dorsal MCP and PIP joints.
Serum creatine kinase (CK) serves as the primary biochemical marker tracking active myofiber necrosis.
Malignancy screening remains a mandatory clinical directive in all newly diagnosed adult dermatomyositis cases.

questions.explanation_en: Gout is caused by monosodium urate with needle crystal and negative birefringence and CPPD with positive rhomboid crystal. Acute attack is treated with NSAID, colchicine or steroid and initiation/modification of urate-lowering with anti-attack cover. Septic arthritis is always an important distinction and the presence of crystals does not rule out infection. The urate goal is usually below 6 mg/dL.

Concomitant low-dose colchicine flare prophylaxis is mandatory for the first 3 to 6 months of allopurinol.
If a flare strikes a patient already taking allopurinol maintenance, the dose is maintained without interruption.
Target serum uric acid levels are set below 6 mg/dL (or <5 mg/dL in severe tophaceous disease).

The American Academy of Ophthalmology mandates baseline ophthalmic screening followed by annual surveillance utilizing automated visual field perimetry (10-2) and spectral-domain OCT.

Early identification of subclinical toxicity with SD-OCT allows cessation before central visual loss ensues.
Concomitant tamoxifen use, chronic renal impairment, and cumulative dose >1000g accelerate retinal risk.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «U/A، CBC diff، ANA» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.

micro.lead_en: Initial diagnostic workup for a patient presenting with classic lupus hallmarks (polyarthritis and photosensitive malar rash) fundamentally combines: 1) antinuclear antibody (ANA) testing (>98% sensitivity); 2) complete blood count with differential (evaluating leukopenia, lymphopenia, or thrombocytopenia); and 3) comprehensive urinalysis (screening for occult lupus nephritis).
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Initial workup in suspected SLE: ANA (highly sensitive) + CBC diff (cytopenias) + urinalysis (nephritis).

دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: A negative high-titer ANA virtually excludes systemic lupus erythematosus from the differential diagnosis.
Urinalysis represents the simplest, highest-yield screening modality identifying early glomerulonephritis.
Following positive ANA screening, confirmatory high-specificity autoantibodies (anti-dsDNA, anti-Sm) are drawn.
Quantifying baseline complement fractions C3 and C4 aids subsequent monitoring of immunologic flares.

micro.lead_en: Plantar fasciitis is the leading etiology of plantar heel pain in adults, characterized by sharp medial calcaneal tuberosity tenderness. The hallmark symptom is excruciating 'first-step' pain upon waking or rising after prolonged rest that moderates with ambulation. First-line therapy is conservative: targeted plantar/Achilles stretching, supportive footwear/heel cups, and short-course NSAIDs.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Sharp heel pain with first morning steps = plantar fasciitis; initial management: stretching, massage, and NSAIDs.
points_fa: گزینه برتر: ماساژ موضعی و مصرف NSAID
دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Presence of a radiographic calcaneal spur is an incidental finding, neither causative nor warranting surgery.
Rigorous home-based stretching of the plantar fascia and calf gastroc-soleus complex accelerates recovery.
Night dorsiflexion splints prevent nocturnal fascial contracture in recalcitrant presentations.
Intralesional corticosteroid injection is reserved for refractory cases but risks plantar fat pad atrophy and rupture.

micro.lead_en: Articular cartilage is inherently devoid of neural endings and microvascular networks (aneural and avascular), precluding it from directly sensing or generating pain. Joint pain in osteoarthritis originates entirely from contiguous innervated tissues: the synovial lining (low-grade synovitis triggered by cartilage fragments), subchondral bone microfractures, osteophytic periosteal stretching, and the fibrous capsule.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Articular cartilage has no nerve supply; OA joint pain originates from the synovium, subchondral bone, and capsule.
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Cartilage degradation sheds matrix microparticles, inciting low-grade secondary synovial inflammation.
Marginal osteophytes generate mechanical strain against the pain-sensitive, highly innervated periosteum.
Strengthening periarticular musculature stabilizes the articulation, unloading vulnerable subchondral bone.
Intra-articular corticosteroid administration suppresses local synovial inflammation, yielding rapid pain relief.

micro.lead_en: Polyarteritis nodosa (PAN) is a necrotizing vasculitis selectively targeting medium-sized muscular arteries while sparing pulmonary vessels and glomerular capillaries. Key features include mesenteric angina, renovascular hypertension, mononeuritis multiplex, and deep ischemic cutaneous ulcers. The hallmark clue is severe renal arteritis yielding renal insufficiency with normal urinalysis.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Postprandial abdominal pain + mononeuritis multiplex + hypertension + normal urinary sediment = polyarteritis nodosa.
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Visceral catheter angiography reveals characteristic multiple microaneurysms along renal and mesenteric trees.
Strong etiologic association exists between secondary PAN and chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection.
Standard immunosuppression for idiopathic systemic PAN pairs high-dose corticosteroids with cyclophosphamide.
Glomerular capillaries are spared, accounting for the absence of cellular casts and glomerulonephritis.

An L4-L5 disc herniation impinges upon the exiting L5 nerve root, precipitating posterolateral calf pain, dorsum foot paresthesias, and toe/wrist extensor weakness (impaired heel walking). micro.lead_en: Differentiating articular from periarticular pathology is a foundational musculoskeletal clinical skill. Articular pathology produces deep, diffuse joint pain accompanied by equivalent restriction of both active and passive ranges of motion. Conversely, periarticular conditions (tendinitis, bursitis) selectively impair active motion while passive excursion remains relatively preserved.

micro.golden_en: Articular pain: equivalent active and passive motion loss; selective active loss = periarticular/tendon lesion.

points_en: Focal point tenderness over an anatomical landmark remote from the joint line indicates bursitis or enthesitis.
Circumferential effusion tracking the anatomic synovial contour confirms true intra-articular disease.
Resisted active isometric muscular contraction triggers localized pain in tendinitis but is painless in pure arthritis.
True mechanical locking alongside deep joint line pain establishes intra-articular loose bodies or meniscal tears.

Short-acting oral captopril is titrated rapidly every 8 hours toward normalized systolic parameters.
Mild transient elevations in creatinine during ACE-inhibitor initiation must not prompt drug withdrawal.

Symptoms remain purely axial and localized across the lumbar spine and paraspinal muscles without radiating into the lower extremities, in stark contrast to herniated discs, facet arthropathy, or canal stenosis.

Neurological examination (motor strength, light touch sensation, DTRs, and SLR) is strictly unremarkable.

Its specificity dramatically surpasses rheumatoid factor, confirming the definitive diagnosis while reliably predicting erosive radiographic joint progression.

micro.lead_en: Articular involvement in systemic lupus erythematosus is characteristically inflammatory, symmetric, and strictly non-erosive on plain radiography, in marked contrast to the destructive osseous erosions typical of rheumatoid arthritis. Reversible deformities like Jaccoud's arthropathy stem from ligamentous laxity rather than bone destruction.

points_en: Jaccoud's arthropathy features tendon laxity resulting in completely reducible hand deformities without erosions.
Avascular osteonecrosis of the femoral head represents a prominent hazard of steroid therapy and vasculopathy in SLE.
The exceptional overlap of true erosive polyarthritis alongside systemic lupus is designated 'Rhupus'.
Lupus articular flares are managed with hydroxychloroquine and low-dose corticosteroid bridging.

Diagnostic classification hinges on demonstrated clinical vascular thrombosis (deep vein thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, stroke) or obstetric morbidities occurring in the setting of persistent antiphospholipid antibodies, often marked by baseline thrombocytopenia.

points_en: Laboratory criteria mandate documented lupus anticoagulant, anticardiolipin, or anti-beta-2-glycoprotein-I positivity.
Established venous thrombosis requires indefinite therapeutic oral anticoagulation with warfarin (target INR 2.0-3.0).
Concomitant hydroxychloroquine therapy exerts proven antithrombotic protection in lupus patients.
Direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) are inferior to warfarin, showing higher recurrent thrombosis rates in high-risk APS.

micro.lead_en: The 2010 ACR/EULAR Rheumatoid Arthritis Classification Criteria allocate weighted scores across 4 domains (threshold ≥6/10 for diagnosis). Joint involvement carries the highest single weight, where >10 joints (incorporating at least 1 small joint) receives 5 points, contrasted with high-titer serology (3 points) and abnormal acute-phase reactants (1 point).

micro.lead_en: A fundamental tenet in rheumatology governs axial skeletal involvement in rheumatoid arthritis: RA strictly spares the thoracic spine, lumbar spine, and sacroiliac joints. The cervical spine (specifically the synovial atlantoaxial complex C1-C2 and subaxial facet joints) is the sole axial segment targeted, risking odontoid erosion, ligamentous laxity, and catastrophic cord compression.

micro.lead_en: Psoriatic arthritis exhibits several discrete phenotypic subforms; the symmetric polyarthritis pattern mimics rheumatoid arthritis so convincingly that it is frequently misdiagnosed as seronegative RA. Critical discriminators favoring PsA include concurrent distal interphalangeal (DIP) involvement, nail dystrophy/pitting, dactylitis, and absence of rheumatoid nodules/RF.

points_en: DIP joint involvement is virtually absent in rheumatoid arthritis but distinctly frequent in psoriatic arthritis.
Identifying discrete nail pitting or onycholysis serves as a vital diagnostic clue uncovering occult psoriasis.
Radiographic imaging in PsA demonstrates destructive 'pencil-in-cup' osteolysis juxtaposed with periostitis.
Patients presenting with psoriatic polyarthritis are characteristically seronegative for both RF and ACPA.

Landmark clinical manifestations include: 1) postprandial abdominal angina with severe weight loss resulting from mesenteric ischemia; 2) mononeuritis multiplex (such as radial nerve palsy causing wrist drop); and 3) renal insufficiency characterized by a completely normal urinary sediment due to sparing of glomerular capillaries.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Postprandial abdominal angina + wrist drop + renal insufficiency with normal sediment = polyarteritis nodosa.

points_en: Catheter mesenteric/renal angiography uncovers pathognomonic saccular microaneurysms and arterial stenoses.
Small-vessel vasculitides and SLE invariably induce active sediment with hematuria and red cell casts.
Screening for underlying hepatitis B virus (HBV) surface antigen and DNA is clinically mandated.
Systemic immunosuppression with high-dose corticosteroids paired with cyclophosphamide controls active vasculitis.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «نارسایی کلیه و فشار خو ن» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «نارسایی کلیه و فشار خو ن» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Inflammatory arthritis is characterized by prolonged morning stiffness, joint swelling, and improvement with movement. RA mainly involves the MCP/PIP and the wrist symmetrically, and anti-CCP is more specific. Spondyloarthritis is associated with axial pain, enthesitis, dactylitis and HLA-B27. Synovial fluid in acute monoarthritis is necessary to rule out septic/crystal arthritis. Early DMARD therapy prevents structural damage.

micro.lead_en: Anti-centromere-positive limited cutaneous systemic sclerosis (CREST syndrome) characteristically exhibits calcinosis, severe Raynaud's, esophageal dysmotility, and late isolated pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Scleroderma renal crisis and rapidly progressive renal failure are extraordinarily rare in this subset, occurring predominantly in diffuse systemic sclerosis with anti-RNA polymerase III.

micro.lead_en: Anti-SSA (anti-Ro) autoantibodies are intimately tied to photosensitive cutaneous lupus erythematosus (subacute cutaneous LE) and transplacental autoimmune fetal injury. Maternal IgG crossing the placenta targets fetal AV nodal cardiac tissue, permanently scarring conduction pathways to induce congenital third-degree heart block in neonatal lupus syndrome.

points_en: Congenital heart block risk in an anti-Ro-positive pregnancy is ~2%, escalating to ~18% after an affected child.
Serial fetal Doppler echocardiography is rigorously conducted every 1-2 weeks from gestational weeks 16 to 26.
Neonatal cutaneous lupus rash spontaneously wanes within 6 months as transplacental maternal antibodies clear.
Complete fetal AV block is irreversible, ultimately necessitating permanent cardiac pacemaker implantation at birth.

micro.lead_en: De Quervain's tenosynovitis involves stenosing tenosynovitis of the first extensor dorsal compartment containing the abductor pollicis longus (APL) and extensor pollicis brevis (EPB) tendons. Classically afflicting postpartum mothers lifting infants, the diagnostic standard is Finkelstein's test (passive ulnar wrist deviation with the thumb folded within a clenched fist).

points_en: Tinel's and Phalen's maneuvers selectively assess median nerve compression across the carpal tunnel.
Yergason's and Speed's tests evaluate proximal biceps tendon pathology at the shoulder.
Conservative management incorporates a rigid thumb-spica splint and a short course of oral NSAIDs.
Intralesional corticosteroid injection into the first extensor tendon sheath cures >80% of persistent cases.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «شرح حال و معاینه ی فیزیکی کافی بوده و نیاز به اقدام خاصی نیست» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «شرح حال و معاینه ی فیزیکی کافی بوده و نیاز به اقدام خاصی نیست» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.

Synovial fluid in acute monoarthritis is necessary to rule out septic/crystal arthritis. Early DMARD therapy prevents structural damage.

micro.lead_en: Validated ACR and EULAR clinical practice guidelines emphasize that in individuals aged ≥45-50 presenting with classic mechanical knee pain (activity-related ache relieved by rest), brief morning stiffness (<30 minutes), and crepitus without red flags, the diagnosis of osteoarthritis is established clinically; routine radiography or MRI is unnecessary.

Prominent nocturnal resting pain or constitutional red flags warrant structural radiographic evaluation.
Initial management prioritizes weight reduction, low-impact exercise, quadriceps strengthening, and topical NSAIDs.
Weight-bearing knee radiographs are reserved for atypical presentations, rapid deterioration, or arthroplasty planning.

Conversely, knee and hip osteoarthritis are predominantly governed by mechanical load and obesity.

The hallmark clinical sign is sharp lateral epicondylar pain provoked by resisted wrist extension with the elbow in extension (Cozen's test) and resisted middle finger extension.

Over 95% of presentations arise in non-athletes engaging in repetitive manual forearm pronation/supination.
A counterforce forearm band dissipates tensile forces across the diseased common extensor tendon origin.

Prednisone is rapidly inactivated by placental 11-beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase 2, shielding the fetus.

micro.lead_en: Pes anserine bursitis is a prevalent etiology of medial knee pain in middle-aged women, frequently co-occurring with knee osteoarthritis. The bursa underlies the conjoined tendinous insertions of the sartorius, gracilis, and semitendinosus muscles at the anteromedial proximal tibia. Striking focal tenderness 5 cm distal to the medial joint line with normal passive ROM localizes the bursa.

دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: True intra-articular range of motion is completely preserved without an accompanying joint effusion.

Conservative care prioritizes hamstring stretching, quadriceps stabilization, weight loss, and oral NSAIDs.
Targeted local corticosteroid instillation directly into the anserine bursa yields rapid, enduring relief.

micro.lead_en: Renal insufficiency (creatinine 2.5 mg/dL) dramatically dictates therapeutic choices in acute gouty arthritis. NSAIDs are strictly contraindicated due to acute prostaglandin blockade precipitating acute tubular necrosis, while colchicine is avoided due to clearance failure and fatal neuromyopathy. Systemic glucocorticoids (oral prednisone 30-35 mg/day) represent the treatment of choice.

points_en: Intra-articular triamcinolone injection is exceptionally effective, bypassing systemic steroid metabolism.
Oral prednisone is administered as a short 5- to 10-day burst without risking further nephrotoxicity.
Urate-lowering therapy with allopurinol must not be instituted until the acute flare has fully resolved.
Subsequent allopurinol titration demands conservative dose reductions calibrated to residual renal clearance.

Measuring synovial fluid glucose, total protein, or LDH levels is definitively obsolete, exhibiting negligible diagnostic sensitivity or specificity, and offers the least clinical assistance.

Prompt empirical broad-spectrum parenteral antibiotics must be instituted directly following arthrocentesis.

micro.lead_en: Raynaud's phenomenon in systemic sclerosis stems from microvascular vasospasm superimposed on structural intimal proliferation. Dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers are first-line vasodilators. Conversely, beta-blockers are strictly contraindicated; by blocking vascular beta-2 mediated dilation, they leave alpha-mediated vasoconstriction unopposed, precipitating severe digital ischemia and gangrene.

points_en: Long-acting oral nifedipine substantially decreases both the frequency and severity of ischemic vasospastic attacks.
Beta-blockers critically compromise cutaneous digital microcirculation, worsening digital ulcerations.
Phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors (sildenafil) and prostacyclin analogs are designated for refractory ischemic ulcers.
Systemic cold avoidance, core warming, and smoking cessation remain non-negotiable conservative tenets.

micro.lead_en: While typical mechanical symptoms in older adults raise high clinical suspicion for knee osteoarthritis, plain weight-bearing radiography remains the standard diagnostic and staging tool under ACR criteria. Radiographs establish joint space narrowing, marginal osteophytes, and Kellgren-Lawrence grade, rendering the assertion that knee OA 'never requires radiography' incorrect.

points_en: Weight-bearing views are indispensable to objectively unmask true functional cartilage narrowing.
Atypical symptoms (acute onset, locked joint, nocturnal rest pain) demand prompt radiographic evaluation.

Pathogenic maternal IgG crosses the syncytiotrophoblast starting at gestational week 16, eliciting autoimmune myocarditis that permanently scars the fetal AV node (congenital complete heart block). Positivity dictates fetal echo surveillance.

points_en: The baseline risk of fetal heart block in an anti-Ro-positive primigravida is roughly 2%.
Following an index affected infant, the recurrence risk in subsequent pregnancies rises tenfold to ~18%.
Maternal hydroxychloroquine mitigates inflammatory transplacental insult, offering significant protection.
Concurrent antiphospholipid antibody screening is mandatory to evaluate pregnancy loss and preeclampsia hazards.

Routine pharmacovigilance prioritizes early interception of myelosuppression and hepatic parenchymal toxicity. Validated ACR safety guidelines dictate checking a complete blood count (CBC), serum creatinine, and liver transaminases (ALT/AST) every 8 to 12 weeks during stable maintenance.

Serum creatinine monitoring is indispensable because methotrexate excretion is entirely renal.

Heberden's nodes represent hard, bony marginal osteophytes rather than soft-tissue inflammatory synovitis.
Systemic immunosuppressive agents (methotrexate) are strictly devoid of efficacy in primary hand osteoarthritis.

micro.lead_en: Polyarteritis nodosa (PAN) is historically and pathologically defined by necrotizing inflammation of medium-sized muscular arteries. A cornerstone negative criterion is the strict sparing of glomerular capillaries and pulmonary vasculature. Consequently, glomerulonephritis and cellular urine casts are characteristically absent, with renal damage mediated by renovascular ischemia.

points_en: Renal insufficiency in PAN is uniquely characterized by a bland, inactive urinary sediment.
Mononeuritis multiplex (foot drop, wrist drop) represents the most common neurological hallmark of PAN.
Mesenteric arteritis provokes severe postprandial abdominal angina, nausea, and profound weight loss.
Presence of glomerulonephritis or alveolar hemorrhage excludes classic PAN, confirming ANCA-associated vasculitis.

micro.lead_en: Acute anterior uveitis (iritis/iridocyclitis) is the most frequent extra-articular manifestation of ankylosing spondylitis, occurring in 25-40% of patients. Pathognomonic features are an explosive acute onset, strictly unilateral presentation, intense ocular pain, photophobia, and ciliary flush. It resolves within 4-8 weeks, frequently recurring alternately in either eye.

points_en: Simultaneous bilateral chronic anterior uveitis is characteristic of sarcoidosis or juvenile idiopathic arthritis, not AS.
Over 90% of ankylosing spondylitis patients developing anterior uveitis are HLA-B27 positive.
Immediate emergency ophthalmic intervention pairs intensive topical corticosteroid drops with cycloplegics.
Treatment delays risk posterior synechiae formation, cataracts, secondary glaucoma, and irreversible visual loss.

micro.lead_en: Rheumatoid arthritis patients receiving immunosuppressive therapy (methotrexate and corticosteroids) carry a heightened vulnerability to joint sepsis, predominantly Staphylococcus aureus. An acute febrile presentation featuring a solitary hot, swollen knee represents septic arthritis until proven otherwise. Escalating corticosteroid dosage blunts host defense, facilitating invasive articular destruction.

دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Underlying rheumatoid synovial joint architecture combined with immunosuppressive drugs creates ideal grounds for sepsis.
Emergent arthrocentesis for synovial leukocyte count, Gram stain, and culture is the cardinal clinical directive.
Blood cultures must be procured concurrently to identify hematogenous bacteremic seeding.
Bactericidal parenteral antibiotic therapy (e.g., intravenous vancomycin) must be initiated without delay.

micro.lead_en: Management of a first-ever acute gout attack prioritizes rapid anti-inflammatory relief utilizing full-dose scheduled NSAIDs (such as naproxen 500 mg twice daily) or low-dose colchicine. Urate-lowering therapy (allopurinol) is never initiated during an acute flare, and a single uncomplicated attack does not warrant long-term ULT initiation.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: First acute gout attack with intact renal function = full-dose naproxen; initiating allopurinol is contraindicated.
points_fa: گزینه برتر: ناپروکسن 500mg دو بار در ر وز
دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Full-dose naproxen is maintained continuously until 48-72 hours following total clinical symptom resolution.
Initiating allopurinol amidst acute inflammation destabilizes articular urate pools, severely prolonging the flare.
Long-term allopurinol therapy is withheld until validated recurrence criteria (≥2 flares/year, tophi) are met.
Lifestyle education addressing purine restriction and hydration is delivered during the intercritical phase.

micro.lead_en: Drug-induced lupus erythematosus (DILE) manifests with constitutional symptoms, serositis, and arthralgias following chronic exposure to inciting pharmacological agents. While procainamide and hydralazine carry the highest risk, the ACE inhibitor captopril is an established culprit due to its reactive sulfhydryl moiety. Anti-histone antibodies are positive in >95% of DILE cases.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Antihypertensive agent capable of inducing drug-induced lupus = captopril (hallmark: anti-histone antibodies).
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Circulating anti-histone antibodies are present in >95% of patients with drug-induced lupus erythematosus.
Severe renal glomerulonephritis and central nervous system manifestations are characteristically absent in DILE.
Discontinuation of the offending pharmaceutical agent leads to complete clinical resolution over weeks to months.
Other high-risk inciting medications encompass hydralazine, procainamide, isoniazid, and minocycline.

نادرست است؛ دلیل رد: «تاندونیت عضله ی دو سر» در مقایسه با پاسخ صحیح و شرایط بالینی بیمار در هاریسون، اقدام اولویت‌دار یا انتخاب اول بالینی محسوب نمی‌شود.

پاتوفیزیولوژی و استدلال گایدلاین هاریسون: انتخاب «کپسولیت چسبنده» بر اساس رویکرد گام‌به‌گام طب مبتنی بر شواهد استوار است. این استراتژی درمانی/تشخیصی با هدف تثبیت وضعیت همودینامیک، مهار فرآیندهای پاتولوژیک زمینه‌ای و کاهش مورتالیتی و موربیدیتی ناشی از بیماری اتخاذ می‌گردد. در مدیریت بالینی این بیماری، توازن دقیق میان منافع مداخله و خطرات عوارض جانبی مطابق سرفصل‌های به‌روزشده هاریسون برقرار شده است.

ارزیابی تحلیلی گزینه‌های دیگر: سایر گزینه‌ها به دلیل اثربخشی کمتر، تطابق ناکافی با معیارهای قطعی راهنماهای بالینی، یا داشتن عوارض جانبی و تأخیر در روند بهبودی در مقایسه با «کپسولیت چسبنده» در اولویت بعدی قرار گرفته و رد می‌شوند.
questions.explanation_en: Inflammatory arthritis is characterized by prolonged morning stiffness, joint swelling, and improvement with movement. RA mainly involves the MCP/PIP and the wrist symmetrically, and anti-CCP is more specific. Spondyloarthritis is associated with axial pain, enthesitis, dactylitis and HLA-B27. Synovial fluid in acute monoarthritis is necessary to rule out septic/crystal arthritis. Early DMARD therapy prevents structural damage.

micro.lead_en: Adhesive capsulitis (frozen shoulder) involves progressive contracture of the glenohumeral capsule, exhibiting a five-fold heightened incidence among diabetic cohorts. The definitive physical examination finding is painful restriction of both active and passive motion across all planes, characteristically targeting external rotation.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «روماتولوژی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Shoulder pain in a diabetic with global restriction of motion in all planes = adhesive capsulitis (frozen shoulder).
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Loss of passive external rotation with the arm at the side is the most sensitive early clinical sign.
Rotator cuff tears preserve passive glenohumeral excursion, distinguishing them from true capsular contracture.
Optimal glycemic control remains an essential foundational strategy reducing connective tissue glycation.
Intra-articular glenohumeral corticosteroid injections significantly shorten the painful inflammatory phase.

micro.lead_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL, AML-M3) is an oncologic emergency characterized by life-threatening disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC) with hyperfibrinolysis, driven by procoagulant release from abnormal promyelocytes packed with Auer rods. The defining cytogenetic hallmark is the reciprocal translocation t(15;17)(q22;q21), fusing the PML and RARA genes.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «داخلی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: AML complicated by severe coagulopathy and DIC = acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL); cytogenetics: t(15;17).
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Initiation of ATRA (all-trans retinoic acid) must precede genetic confirmation to halt fatal coagulopathy.
Prolonged PT/PTT, elevated fibrin degradation products (FDPs), and hypofibrinogenemia establish consumptive DIC.
Arsenic trioxide (ATO) combined with ATRA achieves complete cure rates exceeding 95% without cytotoxic chemotherapy.
Surveillance for APL differentiation syndrome (fever, pulmonary infiltrates, fluid overload) is mandatory.

micro.lead_en: Inflammatory back pain in a young adult (nocturnal waking, relief with exercise, worsening with rest) alongside heel enthesitis prompts suspicion for axial spondyloarthritis. MRI of the sacroiliac joints is the diagnostic gold standard identifying early active bone marrow edema. HLA-B27 testing is an etiologic genetic marker, not a definitive standalone diagnostic tool.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «داخلی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Definitive diagnostic tool for axial spondyloarthritis = sacroiliac joint MRI; HLA-B27 alone is not diagnostic.
points_fa: دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Short tau inversion recovery (STIR) sequence MRI visualizes active inflammatory subchondral bone marrow edema.
Morning heel pain reflects enthesitis localized to the Achilles tendon or plantar fascial calcaneal insertions.
While >90% of AS patients carry HLA-B27, ~8% of healthy individuals also express it, making it non-diagnostic alone.
Continuous, scheduled high-dose nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs represent the definitive first-line pharmacotherapy.

micro.lead_en: Evaluation of acute low back pain pivots on identifying red flag clinical indicators that mandate immediate radiographic imaging. Point bony tenderness elicited by firm percussion directly overlying a specific vertebral spinous process carries strong predictive value for vertebral compression fracture, spinal epidural infection, or osseous metastasis.
micro.golden_fa: نکته هاریسون: در «داخلی»، تقدم با کامل‌ترین تطابق با معیارهای تشخیصی است.
micro.golden_en: Low back pain red flag: focal spinous process tenderness on percussion = urgent radiography for fracture or infection.
points_fa: گزینه برتر: حساسیت مهره دوم در دق ستون فقرات
دام: گزینه ناقص را با کامل اشتباه نگیر
points_en: Uncomplicated mechanical back pain devoid of red flags warrants watchful waiting without imaging for 4-6 weeks.
In patients >50 years, focal vertebral tenderness strongly suggests acute osteoporotic insufficiency fracture.
Fever, rigors, and elevated ESR alongside point vertebral tenderness indicate pyogenic spondylodiscitis.

micro.lead_en: Primary spontaneous pneumothorax typically strikes tall, slender young men in their twenties due to spontaneous rupture of apical subpleural blebs. Physical examination hallmarks feature sudden pleuritic chest pain, hyperresonance to percussion, diminished or absent breath sounds on the affected hemithorax, and contralateral tracheal deviation in tension pneumothorax.

points_en: Contralateral tracheal deviation heralds tension pneumothorax, demanding emergent immediate needle decompression.
Upright expiratory chest radiography establishes the visceral pleural line devoid of peripheral bronchovascular markings.
Cigarette smoking elevates the lifetime risk of primary spontaneous pneumothorax up to twenty-fold.
Large (>2-3 cm) or symptomatic pneumothoraces require chest tube thoracostomy or pigtail catheter drainage.
